title: Open Robotics ROS 2 sros2 load_policy XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure… (CVE-2026-134044)
description: CVE-2026-134044 is an XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in Open Robotics ROS 2 sros2 load_policy functionality. It allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information by exploiting improper XML parsing of policy files. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as visiting a malicious page or opening a crafted file. The vulnerability could be leveraged with other flaws to execute arbitrary code under the current user context.
